content.title: Shell V-Power® NiTRO+ premium gasoline | Shell USA, Inc.
content.text: Protect your vehicle against buildup and wearShell V-Power® NiTRO+ can help your engine performance today and protect against problems down the road. Our premium gasoline can prevent the future buildup of carbon deposits, provide unbeatable protection against corrosion and give our best protection against wear and friction.DepositsCarbon deposits can build up on your engine’s intake valves and fuel injectors, which can reduce gas mileage and engine performance. Shell V- Power® NiTRO+ has six times the cleaning agents as federal standards require, so it can remove baked-in deposits left by lower-quality premium gasoline starting with the very first tank. And with continual use, Shell V-Power® NiTRO+ can help prevent future buildup of those same performance-robbing deposits.CorrosionCorrosion comes from moisture and other contaminants that make their way into your fuel tank, keeping your engine from running at full potential. Corrosion can impact the fuel pump, fuel lines and fuel injectors. Particles from corrosive processes can also block your fuel filters. Shell V-Power® NiTRO+ helps inhibit corrosion with regular use, keeping your fuel systems running at their best. WearEngine wear can lead to a loss of engine oil and power, as well as more tailpipe pollution. In your pistons and fuel system, wear can happen slowly over time when metal surfaces rub against each other. Fortunately, with continuous use, Shell V-Power® NiTRO+ is specifically engineered for these areas to minimize wear.FrictionExcessive friction reduces your engine’s efficiency and can lower your gas mileage. It occurs in your engine as the pistons move against cylinder walls. Too much friction can damage metal surfaces, increasing wear on critical engine parts. With continuous use, Shell V-Power NiTRO+ reduces unwanted friction in your engine.2
